page.body:
Import Properties

Estimated reading: 1 minute 1025 views

Import Your Listings:

  1. During sign-up make sure to have your import URL from your current property listing company. The URL should point to an XML feed containing only your own property data. “own properties”

  2. Paste the import URL to start the import process. Our software handles all major formats seamlessly. (For any issues, please contact support)

  3. Done. Your listing will be approved, usually within a few business hours.

Please note:  Imports are accepted during sign-up to quickly upload all your properties. After that, you need to update properties within the PropertyList platform and add new properties manually.

If you did not upload at sign-in and need to add your xml link please contact support.
